title: I made a slot machine game where you eventually become too lazy to pull the lever yourself
author: nrttn27
selftext:
Hey! I've been working on Infinite Spin for a while now. It's basically an incremental game where you start with a simple slot machine and keep upgrading it.

At first you pull the lever yourself, but later you can get a robot called LEVERBOT to do it for you. You can unlock more reels, choose different upgrades and the machine and surroundings changes as you progress.

I’ve been developing it with the help of AI coding tools. The game uses three.js, and the machine, environments and sounds are generated procedurally in code.

The game is still in development and there are quite a few things I want to improve. One of them is the coins piling up on the floor. I want the pile to get bigger and bigger so you can actually see how much progress you've made. Still trying to figure out how to make it look good without destroying performance lol.

I'd really like to hear what you guys think. Especially if you have any ideas about the coin pile or gameplay in general.

Also, no real money or microtransactions. Everything is just in-game coins.

Here's the Steam page if anyone wants to check it out: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5419510/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5419510/)
